facts.business: GE Power India Limited is a leading player in the Indian power generation equipment market, offering a comprehensive portfolio of power generation solutions with a focus on emissions control and services, including Steam Power, Services, Automation and Control, Boilers, Mills, and Air Quality Control Systems.

auditor.name: M/s. Deloitte Haskins and Sells, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Evolving trade policies tested the adaptability of businesses and supply chains worldwide
Near-term volatility in global economic landscape
Dependence on Parent Corporate Guarantees for banking support requirements
facts.related_party_note: The Company has significant related party transactions with GE Vernova Inc. (ultimate Parent Company, 68.58% shareholding) including Parent Corporate Guarantees up to ₹16,000 million for fund-based and non-fund based facilities, guarantee for cash pool arrangement lending to LM Wind Power Blades (India) Private Limited up to ₹10,000 million, and support/shared services up to ₹250 million. These transactions exceed 10% of annual consolidated turnover and require member approval.
